item.description:
CoreBlow 2.1.5

Fixes

  • Web Control UI & Build Order: Reordered root build so compiled Control UI assets remain intact, aligned Control UI Ed25519 WebSocket handshake and URL connect form, replaced javascript:void(0) and inline hover handlers, fixed Command Palette trigger, and eliminated CSP frame violations in CoreHub/Nodes.
  • Studio Desktop: Forwarded resolved Gateway URL via IPC/preload, cleaned CSP without unsafe-eval, and fixed Electron Node worker spawning.
  • Plugins, MCP & Diagnostics: Resolved circular jiti import crash in memory-core, aligned extension host bounds, exposed all 75 sovereign native tools in standalone coreblow mcp serve, and accelerated coreblow status --all under 5 seconds.
